description.zh: 用户人脸图片的唯一标识符。请传入在调用[AddFaceUserPicutre](~~312040~~)接口为用户添加人脸图片后，获取并保存到本地的**Data**值。
description.en: The unique identifier of the user's face image. Set this parameter to the **Data** value that you obtained and saved locally after calling the [AddFaceUserPicutre](~~312040~~) operation to add a face image for the user.

description.zh: 业务隔离ID，用于隔离同一个阿里云账号下不同业务应用之间的数据。请与调用[AddFaceUser](~~288338~~)接口添加用户时设置的**IsolationId**保持一致。
description.en: The business isolation ID, which is used to isolate data between different business applications under the same Alibaba Cloud account. Set this parameter to the same value of **IsolationId** that you specified when you called the [AddFaceUser](~~288338~~) operation to add the user.

description.zh: 用户ID。请传入在调用[AddFaceUser](~~288338~~)接口添加用户后，获取并保存到本地的**UserId**值。
description.en: The user ID. Set this parameter to the **UserId** value that you obtained and saved locally after calling the [AddFaceUser](~~288338~~) operation to add the user.

descriptions.zh:
## 限制条件
单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为100。
    > RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## Before you begin
The maximum number of queries per second (QPS) per Alibaba Cloud account for invoking this operation is 100.
    > Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.
